# Visit Northeast

> > Comprehensive travel guide to Northeast India, West Bengal, and Eastern Himalayas featuring destinations, cultural heritage sites, and responsible tourism resources.

Visit Northeast is a tourism portal covering destinations across Northeast India's seven sister states, West Bengal's hill stations and heritage sites, and the Dooars-Duars region. The site provides detailed guides to mountain retreats, wildlife sanctuaries, Buddhist monasteries, and cultural landmarks from Darjeeling to Mizoram.

## Key Topics

- Northeast India
- West Bengal
- Darjeeling
- Dooars (Duars)
- Kalimpong
- Kolkata
- Siliguri
- Bankura
- Shantiniketan
- Travel destinations
- Cultural heritage
- Tourism
- Hill stations
- Wildlife sanctuaries
- Buddhist monasteries

## Major Destinations & State Guides

- [Kohima](https://www.visitnortheast.com/kohima.html): Nagaland capital with WWII sites, Naga culture, and vibrant festivals
- [Tripura](https://www.visitnortheast.com/tripura.html): Northeast state with ancient temples, wildlife sanctuaries, and culture
- [Bombdila](https://www.visitnortheast.com/bombdila.html): Arunachal Pradesh hill town with monasteries and apple orchards
- [Udaipur](https://www.visitnortheast.com/udaipur.html): Tripura's cultural hub with historic palaces, temples, and scenic lakes
- [Tazpur](https://www.visitnortheast.com/tazpur.html): Northeast India destination covering multiple states and regions

## Dooars Region & Forest Destinations

- [Murti](https://www.visitnortheast.com/murti.html): Dooars riverside destination with forest stays and wildlife safaris
- [Suntalekhola](https://www.visitnortheast.com/suntalekhola.html): Peaceful Dooars forest village with riverside stays and trekking trails
- [Malbazar](https://www.visitnortheast.com/malbazar.html): Jalpaiguri gateway to Dooars with tea gardens and wildlife sanctuaries
- [Jatinga](https://www.visitnortheast.com/jatinga.html): Assam destination in Northeast India travel guide

## Darjeeling & Hill Station Attractions

- [Tiger Hill](https://www.visitnortheast.com/story/tiger-hill.html): Darjeeling sunrise viewpoint for Kanchenjunga and Mount Everest views
- [Ghoom Monastery](https://www.visitnortheast.com/story/ghoom-monastery.html): Darjeeling's oldest Buddhist monastery with 15-foot Maitreya Buddha
- [The Japanese Peace Pagoda](https://www.visitnortheast.com/story/the-japanese-peace-pagoda.html): Darjeeling Buddhist monument with golden Buddhas and Himalayan views
- [Selim Hills](https://www.visitnortheast.com/selim-hills.html): Kurseong mountain retreat with scenic views near Darjeeling

## Mizoram & Eastern Destinations

- [Phawngpui (Blue Mountain)](https://www.visitnortheast.com/phawngpui-blue-mountain.html): Mizoram's highest peak in Phawngpui National Park with trekking trails
- [Saiha](https://www.visitnortheast.com/saiha.html): Southern Mizoram town with Lengteng Wildlife Sanctuary and Vantawng Falls

## Cultural Heritage & Museums

- [Indian Museum](https://www.visitnortheast.com/story/indian-museum.html): India's oldest museum in Kolkata with ancient artifacts and sculptures
- [Shahid Minar](https://www.visitnortheast.com/story/shahid-minar.html): Kolkata monument and M. P. Birla Planetarium with astronomy shows
- [Susunia](https://www.visitnortheast.com/story/susunia.html): Bankura's Susunia Hills with ancient inscriptions and trekking trails

## Travel Resources & Guidelines

- [Code of Conduct in Tourism](https://www.visitnortheast.com/code-of-conduct-in-tourism.html): Ethical travel guidelines for responsible tourism and cultural respect
- [Learn Some Basic Hindi](https://www.visitnortheast.com/learn-some-basic-hindi.html): Basic Hindi phrases and greetings for travelers in Northeast India
